description: Benchmark task (docs/benchmark_rules.md). One Gilbert cell of the thesis's I/Q up-converter (Fig. 4.12) in sky130 (rule D7) at 1.8 V, 27 C, typical models: baseband 20 MHz (AC-coupled, PT3a) up-converted by a 5 GHz LO of 340 mV peak per side (PT5a); output measured at the upper sideband 5.02 GHz (PT4a) across the PT2a drain loads. Targets are the thesis's single-cell values (PT1a) with the 10 % linear tolerance. Nominal condition only (the thesis reports no single-cell metric under PVT variation; rule D3).

source.title: Wideband Up-Converting Mixer for Digital Communications Implemented in 130nm CMOS Technology (MASc thesis, G. Patulea, Carleton University, 2015)
source.figure: Fig. 4.12 (PDF 99): one Gilbert cell of the I/Q up-converter (switching quad T1/T3/T8/T9, baseband pair T10/T11, tail T6, baseband bias divider RP0-RP3, decoupling CV0-CV2)

supply_V.provenance: rule D7: thesis chip 2.0 V exceeds the sky130 1.95 V rating; 1.8 V = the thesis's hand-design supply (PDF 90) and a measured point (PDF 119), sky130 nominal

rf_frequency_Hz.provenance: paper: PDF 102 / 106 (baseband f_BB1 20 MHz; the family's RF input is the baseband input)

lo_amplitude_V.provenance: paper: PDF 102 / 105 (LO 340 mVp from the phase shifter), per side (owner answer PT5a)

port_impedance_ohm.provenance: paper: PDF 91 / 106 (50-ohm system: NF and P1dB 'in 50 Ohm', -11 dBm = 178 mVpp)

constraints.name: conversion_gain_dB
constraints.aggregate: worst case over all conditions and matching points
constraints.provenance: paper: eq. 67-68 PDF 89 (single Gilbert cell voltage gain A_MIX = (2/pi) gm RD designed for 0 dB; PT1a). G6 step 2 (2026-10-27): -3.9 dB (PDF 102) = 20log(2/pi), the loaded/actual-design factor, and 3.74 dB is the post-layout I/Q chip; the unloaded single cell simulated here is eq. 67-68, 0 dB

constraints.name: nf_ssb_dB
constraints.aggregate: worst case over all conditions and matching points
constraints.provenance: paper: eq. 69 PDF 90 (single-cell noise figure in a 50-ohm system, 12.1 dB; PT1a); single-sideband (the up-converter's signal occupies one input band)

constraints.aggregate: worst case over all conditions and matching points
constraints.provenance: paper: eq. 70 PDF 91 / table PDF 109 (single-cell input P1dB -9.3 dBm calculated; PT1a); V1dB 217 mVpp (Table 6) <-> -9.3 dBm by P = Vpp^2/(8*50): matched-port convention (correction 2026-10-27)
